name: XR Replay
summary:
The best moments always happen without warning. The perfect run after twenty attempts, the win pulled off in the last second, the fail that has you in tears laughing: by the time you think to hit record, it's already over. XR Replay is your instant replay for VR gaming, and solves that problem for good.

Once running, XR Replay constantly keeps the last few minutes of your screen and your voice ready to save. The moment something's worth keeping, one tap on Save is all it takes: the moment is already there,
